evals.prompt: List all Auth0 clients and their active connections
expectations: Uses get_clients action to list applications
Uses get_connections action to list identity providers
Returns structured JSON with client names, types, and grant types

evals.prompt: Call the Auth0 agent with an invalid action name 'delete_tenant'
expectations: Returns a validation error listing valid actions
Does NOT attempt any API call
Status field is 'error' with error_code INVALID_ACTION

evals.prompt: Create a new Auth0 client application named 'Test App'
expectations: Response clearly states the agent is read-only
